plain_summary: We first rebuilt the earlier check with our own code and matched every number. On a slightly larger stand-in block the sign-made pair is exact. On a faithful block of 96 sites the record's lowest level beside a fixed partner is still degenerate, four-fold in fact, but it is just as degenerate without the signs. The degeneracy comes from the surroundings: their square pattern has two equal orientations, and the partner's spare link has two equal places. The signs only change its symmetry type. So the doubling survives, but not as sign-made. Freed, the partner swaps the carrier with the record very fast when they are one link apart, so the pair sits side by side. It turns inside one square but does not travel. Every turn gives plus one, so this is not spin. One model family.
